source: https://sportmedical-diagnostics.cz (pages: cenik-sluzeb, sportovni-lekarske-prohlidky, sportovni-diagnostika, zakladni-diagnostika, komplexni-diagnostika, vo2max-analyza, vidoeo-kompenzacne-plany, inbody + Shopify /products.json)
method: WebFetch (HTML->markdown->extraction). Prices cross-checked across at least two pages each; the Shopify product prices come from /products.json (saved 2026-10-03 16:11).
variantSelectors: None. The three Shopify products have a single variant 'Default Title' (no size/option selector). The five packages and every other service are NOT Shopify products: they are price cards on pages; ordering is via the CGM MEDISTAR booking links (cal/3c7bW for medical examinations, cal/9lNfZ for diagnostics and packages) or 'Objednání telefonicky nebo zprávou' (compensation plan, all InBody items).
vat: No DPH statement is published on the Ceník or service pages. Shopify variants: Základní and Komplexní prohlídka taxable=false, Spiroergometrie taxable=true; the product page of Spiroergometrie shows '(including VAT)'. Do not print 'vč. DPH' / 'bez DPH' anywhere until Matko decides.

needsOwnerDecision.text: The live site contradicts itself: Spiroergometrické vyšetření is 3 500 Kč in the Shopify product, the product cards and the comparison table of /pages/sportovni-lekarske-prohlidky, but 4 000 Kč in the 'CENÍK SLUŽEB' card of the same page and on /pages/cenik-sluzeb. The package compare-at prices (5 200 and 6 000) only add up with 4 000. priceCzk below uses 4000 (the Ceník = the price list) and keeps 3500 in alternatePriceCzk.
Two scales are published (see groupDiscounts). Our seed (4->5 %, 6->10 %, 10->15 %) matches neither exactly.
VO2max analýza is 3 500 Kč everywhere on the live site; our catalogue says 4 000.

scaleA.note: 4-5 and 5–9 overlap at 5 persons as published.
